Commentary.Commentary: That's all from us, folks. India have managed to keep their run of consecutive series victories going. The hosts have once again won a Test in not-so-helpful conditions for their bowlers and that should boost their confidence. They next host Australia for a 4-match Test series, starting on 23rd February. The visitors, on the other hand, will be happy with the fight but will know they could have done better. They will go back home with quite some positives. Hope you enjoyed our coverage and will join us for the future games. We bid you goodbye. Cheers!

Indian skipper and Man of the Match, Virat Kohli feels that it was a really good wicket to bat on throughout the five days and also a good toss to win. Applauds the opposition for batting impressively well in the first innings as it meant that they had to work hard for their wickets. Opines that the track was still a good one on Day 5 and it did not offer much, so the bowlers had to do the hard work. Praises Ishant Sharma for bowling well with the older ball, credits Bhuvneshwar Kumar too. Mentions that the presence of the two world class spinners allows him to attack with the pacers. Adds that he is really happy with his batting at the moment. Admits that they thought England was their biggest series but having beaten them 4-0, there is pressure on them to win against Australia. Ends by saying that the guys are really looking forward for the challenge and hopes to perform even better. Applauds the crowd for turning out in numbers as it also pumps up the players.

Bangladesh skipper, Mushfiqur Rahim feels that they created a lot of opportunities in the first innings and it would have been good if they had restricted them to a score under 550-600. Calls it a good performance from the guys as he is proud of them, especially the lower order. Opines that they played sensibly against the number one side in the world and it was a good learning curve for them. Appreciates the fact that they batted more than 100 overs in both the innings. Ends by saying that the guys played well this time and is looking forward to the games against Sri Lanka to get better.

India's batsmen rattled up quick runs in a session in their second innings and that meant Bangladesh had a mammoth target to win. Realistically, a draw was the probable result they were aiming but ended stumps with three wickets down. They did fight hard on the final day but quite a few loose shots cost them big. Mahmudullah was the only batsman to show a lengthy resolve. Bangladesh did compete well but would have wanted to take the game deep into the day. Ashwin and Jadeja were brilliant while Ishant was incisive too. They will acknowledge the fight but will also look to get better and win more games.

Despite staring at a huge score, Bangladesh didn't wilt as they battled hard with Rahim's ton leading the defiance. Shakib and Mehedi also dug in with valuable fifties. They did concede a big lead of 299 but had eaten up enough time for Kohli to shrug off the thought of enforcing the follow-on. India's pacers bowled quite well as the spinners were reduced to a supporting role for a change.

An emphatic win for India to seal the one-off Test. Right from opting to bat, the hosts hardly put a foot wrong with the batsmen piling up a massive total. The in-form skipper, Kohli's double ton was the highlight while Vijay and Saha also compiled centuries. It was a complete batting effort as everybody sans Rahul chipped in. Barring Taijul and to an extent Mehedi, the rest of the bowlers were highly ineffective for Bangladesh.

OUT! INDIA WIN BY 208 RUNS! Very full on leg stump, Taskin looks to flick but is struck on the pads. Big appeal for lbw and one of the close-in fielders has taken the catch as well. Erasmus thinks there is an inside edge and so denies the lbw appeal. However, as the fielder has taken it, he has to go upstairs to confirm if there was a bat involved. The soft signal is OUT. Replays show that there was no inside edge. So, it is a not out regarding the catch. Kohli then nonchalantly opts for the review, which was obvious. Ball Tracker shows that the impact is in line and that's hitting the leg stump. So, that completes a quite comfortable win for India.

What's happened there? There was an appeal for lbw but Erasmus feels there is an inside edge. The catch has been taken too. He isn't sure and decides to refer it upstairs. Soft signal is OUT. Okay, replays show that there is no bat involved. So, India decide to review the lbw eventually.

The players are out in the middle for the second session of the final day. Will the Indian spinners be able to extract more spin from the track and trouble the hosts? Or will the visitors be able to provide resistance? Mahmudullah and Sabbir Rahman will continue with the bat while Ravindra Jadeja will begin the proceedings with the ball for India.
.... DAY 5, SESSION 2 ....

Good session for India to start the day. They got only two wickets but it were the big scalps of Shakib and Rahim. The former was undone by a Jadeja special while the skipper had a brain fade to gift his wicket to Ashwin. Amidst the mess, Mahmudullah batted solidly and has a very nervy Sabbir with him who has tried to look positive. India's spinners were superb while the quicks kept it tight too. The pitch hasn't played that badly and Bangladesh will hope to fight on for a draw, if not an improbable win. They need a big partnership for that to happen. Join us in a while for the post-lunch session to see how things pan out.

Tossed up outside off, gets well on the front foot and defends solidly.
On a length around leg stump, Sabbir misses the flick and is rapped on the pads.
Drifting in from outside off, leans into it and defends solidly.
Tossed up gently around off, presses forward and blocks it solidly.
Fires it in around off, sits back and defends it to cover-point.
Quicker and full around off, Rahman reaches out and blocks solidly.
Fuller on middle and leg, leans across and pushes it towards short mid-wicket.
Quicker ball outside off, sits back and punches it to point.
Flatter outside off, sits back and pushes it towards cover for a single.
Full and outside off, presses forward and defends it well.
Drifting in from around off, Rahman gets behind the line and blocks.
Flatter outside off, sits back and pushes it to the off side.
Fuller outside off, presses forward and blocks it well.
Outside off, defended well from the crease by Mahmudullah.
Drifting in from around off, nicely blocked off the front foot towards short mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, driven firmly towards extra cover where Rahul makes a good stop.
Full and outside off, presses forward to that one and blocks with a straight bat.
Darted in around off, stays back and pushes it towards cover.
Quicker on a length on off, defended solidly off the back foot down the track.
Full and outside off, leans forward and pats it to cover.
The carrom ball but a bit short outside off, punched through cover for a single.
Tossed up outside off, defends it well off the front foot.
FOUR! Nice shot! A touch short and wide outside off, Mahmudullah camps back and cuts it away square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary. Rare bad ball from Ashwin.
Flighted nicely around off, worked with the spin towards short mid-wicket.
On a length outside off, pushed off the back foot towards short third man.
Rahman opens the face of the bat and blocks it towards silly point.
Rahman reaches to the pitch of the ball and plays it down the ground.
Wide outside off, left alone by Rahman.
Floated outside off, Rahman leans into it and defends it.
Floated up, Sabbir gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
Tossed up, Rahman lunges forward and defends it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Almost another wicket as Mahmudullah plays a reckless shot here! Tossed up, the batsman comes down the track goes for a big heave but he gets it through the inner half of the bat. The ball falls just short of the fielder at mid-wicket.
Sabbir Rahman is the next man in.

OUT! Ashwin strikes in his very first over! Bad choice of shot after such a settled knock. The big fish departs and the hosts will be really elated after getting him as he was really vital in the first innings. Floated outside off, Rahim again tries to reach to the pitch of the ball but he is unable to do it this time. He still goes for the shot and the bat turns in his hand as he just hits in the air towards the extra cover region. Jadeja traces back a few steps and takes a fine catch. That is a very big blow to the visitors and is quite similar to the Shakib dismissal in the first innings which also came at a very bad time. The skipper has to walk back and India need just 5 more wickets to win.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! GOOD SHOT! Floated outside off, Rahim dances down the track and drives it elegantly through the cover region for a boundary.
Rahim dances down the track and defends it.
Spin from both ends. Ravichandran Ashwin is called in for a bowl.
Huge shout for LBW! Tossed up outside off and spinning in, Mahmudullah leans forward in defence. He gets an inside edge onto his pads. Jadeja is the only one who appeals and the umpire says no.
Floated outside off, Mahmudullah strides forward and defends it.
Mahmudullah has some issue with his shoes so there is a slight delay in play.
Fuller on the stumps, Rahim  dabs it through the vacant mid-wicket region for a single.
Short and flat on the stumps, Mahmudullah clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
50-run stand between Rahim and Mahmudullah.
Short into the body, Rahim camps back and clips it on the leg side for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Rahim leans forward and defends it.
Angling in from a length outside off, Mahmudullah stays in his crease and defends it on the off side. So that's a maiden.
Into the stumps, Mahmudullah lunges forward and defends it towards the fielder at mid off.
Angling into the stumps from a fuller length, Mahmudullah tries to defend it but the ball flies away towards the fielder at gully after catching the outside edge.
A bit further this time outside off, Mahmudullah stays in his crease and lets that through to the keeper.
Again on a good length outside off, left alone.
Good length delivery outside off, nipped in after pitching. Mahmudullah shoulders his arms to it.
Drinks break....
Around leg stump, Mahmudullah works it wide of mid on for a run.

FOUR! AND AGAIN! This time on the leg side. Advances down the track and lofts it through the line over mid on. Clean strike and it goes to the fence for a boundary. Good positive batting this from the senior man.
FOUR! GOOD SHOT! Drifting on leg stump, Mahmudullah steps out to that one and makes room to launch it high over extra cover. Fine inside out lofted stroke and he gets a boundary.
Full on leg stump, worked to short mid-wicket for a single.
Drifting in from around leg stump, Rahim pads up to it. He was struck in front of the stumps but it pitched outside leg.
Floated on leg stump, Mahmudullah plays inside the line and pats it towards cover for a single.
Good length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Fuller and outside off, Rahim moves forward and defends it well towards cover.
Good length around off, Rahim is on the move as he blocks it firmly back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, punched firmly towards the mid off region. Ishant has overstepped and so it's a no ball.
Good length wider outside off, Rahim pushes loosely at it and is lucky not to get an edge.

SIX! SHOT! Dug in short on middle and leg, Rahim swivels to help it on its way over fine leg with a fluent pull stroke. Quite similar to the first innings maximum that he hit but this was more in control.
THAT WAS CLOSE! Good length outside off, punched to the left of cover and they steal a quick single. Rahim had to hurry but survives as the throw from Jadeja at the keeper's end misses.
Floated on a length around leg stump, Rahim misses the flick and is hit on the pads as the ball goes to short leg.
FOUR! Brave stroke! Rahim is tired of this outside leg stump ploy and brings out the reverse sweep. Connects well to send it through backward point for a boundary.
Loopy on leg stump, Rahim uses his feet and smothers it to the ground.
Very full around leg stump, Rahim defends it with his bat and pad very close together.
On leg stump, Rahim is tight in his forward defence on to the track.
Pitched outside leg stump, Rahim thrusts his pads at it. This line won't trouble the batsmen as far as the lbw goes.
Fuller outside off, Mahmudullah presses forward and defends well.
Good length outside off, blocked solidly off the back foot to the covers.
Fullish and outside off, Mahmudullah pats it back to the bowler.
Huge appeal! Length ball around off, Mahmudullah is rooted on the crease and misses the line to be rapped on the pads. The lbw shout is turned down and rightly so as it was missing leg stump.
Good length outside off, leans forward and steers it with an angled bat towards gully. There are two gullies in place for Ishant, so the ploy would be to hit the deck hard.
Back of a length on middle, Rahim swivels to pull but mistimes it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
ISHANT SHARMA comes on to bowl.
Floated on leg stump, Mahmudullah looks to flick but gets an uppish leading edge. Just falls short of the point fielder.
Once again outside leg, Mahmudullah offers his pads to it.
Ashwin drops back to deep backward square leg.
FOUR! Tossed up outside leg, Mahmudullah decides to go for the big sweep uppishly over backward square leg. No protection behind square on the leg side in the deep and so it's a boundary.
Loopy outside leg, Mahmudullah just pads it away nonchalantly.
Around leg stump, stays back and works it past leg gully for a brace.
Floated around leg stump, gets back to flick but the ball lobs it to leg slip where Kohli reacts brilliantly to take it with one hand. However, there wasn't any bat involved.
Bowled on middle and off, Rahim manages to jam it towards the silly mid on fielder.
On middle and leg, Rahim gets across and defends it out.
Straying on the pads and Rahim shuffles to glance it nicely down to fine leg for a brace. Kumar tidies up near the ropes to save the boundary.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot towards cover.
Good length outside off, stands tall and punches it to the left of the cover fielder for a single.
Fuller and down the leg side, Mahmudullah goes across to flick but misses. Goes on the bounce towards Saha who makes a good stop.
Very full on middle and leg, Rahim just about manages to dig it out.
Pitched outside leg stump, Rahim goes for the sweep but gets it off the glove towards leg slip on the bounce.
Slightly on the shorter side around leg stump, Mahmudullah hangs back and works it wide of mid on for a single.
Drifting in around leg stump, gets on the front foot and nudges it towards short leg.
Floated around leg stump, defended well off the back foot down the pitch.
Around leg stump, Rahim gets back and works it towards square leg for a single.
Great ball! Good length around off, Mahmudullah is neither forward nor back as he hangs his bat at it. The ball moves away late to beat the outside edge.
Good length outside off, gets on the back foot and blocks.
Outside off, reaches out to that one and defends well.
Good length closer to off, Mahmudullah defends it firmly off the back foot to the off side.
Almost fell to the trap! There are two short mid-wickets in place and Mahmudullah's uppish flick just went between the two fielders to the deep.  India won't mind this at all. A couple taken.
Good length outside off, Rahim stays back and defends it towards cover-point.
Drifting in from outside off, Rahim is once again compact in defence.
Slower through the air outside off, draws Rahim forward and he calmly pushes it to silly point.
Flatter and around off, Rahim camps back and defends well.
Quicker and fuller on the stumps, nicely blocked off the front foot.
Fuller around off, Rahim steps out and drives it firmly towards mid off.
Very full and outside off, gets forward and blocks it down the track to the bowler.
Fullish on off, tailing in, Mahmudullah gets across and pushes it to one of the two short mid-wicket fielders that are in place.
Length ball outside off, this time better control from Mahmudullah as he plays with an angled bat towards square third man for a couple.

FOUR! EDGE DOESN'T CARRY! Good length outside off, Mahmudullah pushes at it with soft hands. No footwork but he luckily for him, he didn't play it with hard hands. The thick edge goes on the bounce to Rahul at first slip who gets a hand to it but the ball sneaks through to the third man fence.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and jams it towards the right of the point fielder.
The inswinger is a bit too straight from Yadav and Mahmudullah clips it through short mid-wicket for a couple.
Good length wider outside off, a bit of tail away but the line is far away to make the batsman play.
Full and around off, Rahim pushes at it but gets the outside edge that goes towards point.
Floated outside off, leans into it and blocks towards cover.
Fuller on middle, Rahim gets across to sweep in front of square on the leg side for a couple.
Loopy and on leg stump, gets across and pushes it towards short mid-wicket.
Slightly quicker outside off, hangs back and defends it towards silly point.
On a length around off, slower through the air and Rahim blocks firmly off the back foot.
Full and closer to off, a bit of shape away, Mahmudullah makes a leave to that one.
Pitched outside off, Mahmudullah lifts his bat to make the leave.
The ball seems to have gone out of shape and the Indian players have given it to the umpire who isn't amused. He has a look at it and then gives it back to the hosts.
Fuller on off, tailing in a bit, Mahmudullah covers the inward movement and pushes it with a straight blade to mid on.
Full length ball on middle and leg, gets across and defends it to the leg side.
Loose shot! Back of a length outside off, low bounce as Mahmudullah flashes the cut but misses as the ball sneaks under the bat.
Too straight from Yadav and Mahmudullah works it towards mid-wicket.
Flatter around leg stump, Rahim misses the flick and the ball goes off the pads towards fine leg. They take a couple of leg byes.
Shortish and outside off, reaches out and defends solidly.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and blocks it well.
MUSHFIQUR RAHIM is the new man in.

OUT! GOT HIM! This was always on the cards, considering Shakib's intent but to be fair to him, this was an unplayable ball. On a length outside off, rears up off the rough with sharp inward spin to rap Shakib on the glove. The ball then strikes the thigh pad and bobbles to short leg where Pujara takes an easy catch. Huge wicket for India. Shakib is surprised by the lift on the delivery but he has to go. Jadeja has a wry smile and is inspecting the area from where he got the bite. Expect him to be relentless in that spot.
Uses his feet again to a loopy ball outside off, gets a leading edge past the bowler towards mid off. Shakib is certainly not going to die wondering, especially against Jadeja.
Tossed up wider outside off, Shakib skips down the track and forces it back to the bowler.
Angling in around off, Mahmudullah defends it solidly off the back foot down the pitch.
On the pads, gets across and clips it through square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, lovely fluent drive from Shakib but straight towards cover.
Lovely ball! Full and around off, tails away late to beat the outside edge. Shakib's feet went nowhere on that occasion.
Good length around off, keeps a bit low as Shakib stabs it towards point.
Full and outside off, reaches out and drives it firmly towards extra cover where Kohli makes a fine stop despite having to encounter bad bounce.
UMESH YADAV to bowl from the other end.
Fires it in around off, gets well forward and blocks solidly with a straight bat.
Full and outside off, Mahmudullah pushes at it with soft hands. Gets the edge but doesn't carry to second slip.
Loopy around off, Mahmudullah winds for the big hit and gets it off the inside half through mid-wicket for a brace.
Drifting in from outside off, leans forward and pushes hard at it. Straight to the fielder at silly point.
Slower again outside off, Mahmudullah reaches out and pats it back to the bowler.
Tossed up around off, driven firmly back to the left of Jadeja  who makes a good stop.

The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. If Bangladesh are to harbor any hopes of saving the game, they need a really strong first session. They need their senior men to get going in a big way to put up a fight. MAHMUDULLAH is on strike for the first ball of the day.

Pitch Report - Sanjay Manjrekar says that the infection (cracks) hasn't spread yet. Adds that it is still a really good batting wicket as the cracks are mainly visible on the fuller lengths. Opines that Bangladesh have two batsmen in the middle and two more to come as they look to survive the whole day. Ends by saying that the visitors need to take it to the final hour of play and then assess the situation before they think of going for a win.

The pitch has started to turn and that will benefit the Indian spinners. The spinners would like to make life difficult for the Bangladeshi batsmen who will be looking to bat out the day and achieve a draw, if not a win. Promises to be an exciting day. Stay tuned as the action isn't far away.

Hello and a warm welcome for the final day of the one-off Test match between India and Bangladesh. It should be an exciting day of cricket as the hosts are in sight of victory. They have dominated for the most parts of this Test match but the visitors have also shown resistance while batting. They would once again like to put a good challenge today.
.... DAY 5, SESSION 1 ....

It was a day of contrast for India's bowlers. Their pacers breathed fire in the morning session, leaving the spinners to be sidekicks. However, the roles reversed, as expected in the final session with Ashwin and Jadeja causing plenty of problems for the batsmen with the track opening up just a bit. It will be a huge task for Bangladesh tomorrow to save this game although not impossible. Morning session will be vital for the tourists. Tune in at 0930 local, 0400 GMT for the final day's play. Till then, it's goodbye from us.

Another day that belonged to India. They managed to clean up Bangladesh in the morning session although Rahim did conjure up a defiant ton to keep the hosts at bay for a while. India then rattled up quick runs by the tea break and set Bangladesh a massive target to win. The visitors lost Tamim early but Mominul and Sarkar seemed to steady the ship before both departed in rather quick succession. Shakib and Mahmudullah managed to avoid further dents but the task ahead is humongous for Bangladesh.
JAFFA! Great ball to end the day. Ashwin tries the leg spinner that spins back sharply but it was landed well outside off. Good leave by Shakib. STUMPS ON DAY 4.
Full and outside off, leans forward to that one and blocks well.
On a length on leg stump, nudged off the back foot towards short fine leg. Mahmudullah calls for a single but strangely Shakib sends him back.
Loopy outside off, reaches out and drives it towards cover.
Slower through the air around off, presses forward and blocks it
Flighted on middle and leg, Shakib reaches out to that one and blocks.
Last over of the day coming up.
Pushed through quicker on middle, kept a touch low as Mahmudullah defends it on the back foot with reasonably good adjustment.
On middle and leg, gets across and tucks it towards short mid-wicket.
Fired in around off, rocks back and defends with the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, leans into it and pats it towards point.
Flighted around off, looks to block but gets it off the insdie half to the leg side.
Tossed up outside off, leans forward and drives it strongly to mid off. The fielder at extra cover makes a good stop moving to his right.
On a length on middle and leg, Shakib is solid in defence off his back foot.
Tossed up gently outside off, pushed firmly towards mid off.
Tossed up on off, gets across and clips it towards short fine leg.
Looped up on a length on middle and off, Shakib gets his bat down just in time to block.
Quicker ball on leg stump, gets back and blocks it on to the track.
Quicker and outside off, sits back and punches it towards cover.
Quicker ball outside off, Mahmudullah defends it well off the front foot.
Full and outside off, presses forward and blocks well.
Fired in around off, defended well with a straight bat.
Kohli at second slip goes to mid-wicket and Vijay replaces him in the slip cordon.
Floated up around off, Mahmudullah steps out to heave it away but gets it off the inside half just past short mid-wicket to the deep. A couple taken.
Full and around off, gets well on the front foot to block and it hits him high on the bat. Extra bounce and slight turn too on offer.
Flatter on middle and leg, Mahmudullah stays back and works it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Drifting in from around off, solidly blocked by Shakib.
Flatter on leg stump, gets back to flick but is struck on the pads.

RIPPER! Beautifully looped off break that hisses away after pitching to beat the outside edge. Shakib had no clue about that one. Stifled appeal for a catch but it was more optimistic than anything else.
Drifting in on a length around off, gets on the back foot and defends well.
Quicker ball around off, Shakib stays back and defends it with a solid bat.
Flatter on middle, stays on the back foot and blocks it down the track.
Drifting in from outside off, steps out and whips it away down to long on for a single.
FOUR! DOES IT AGAIN! Flighted ball around off, Shakib uses his reach and again launches it over mid-wicket with a slog sweep. Better contact this time and it almost went all the way for a biggie.
FOUR! Positive intent! Floated around off, Shakib goes across and heaves it away with the turn cleanly over mid-wicket. Good stroke and it finds the fence.
Fired in on middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and defends well.
Flatter on middle and leg, gets back and blocks it to the leg side.
FOUR! Smacked! A bit short outside off, gets back and punches it sweetly through the covers as the ball races to the fence for a boundary. Nice shot.
Full and outside off, reaches out and defends it on to the track.
Looped up outside off, presses forward and defends well.
Fuller outside off, defends it well from the crease.
Floats it up outside off, reaches out and defends well.
Full and around off, steps out and digs it towards silly point. The fielder misses the shy at the keeper's end and they sneak a single off the overthrow.

NOT OUT! Shakib survives by using the technology. Floated outside off, reaches out to block and the ball pops up to short leg where it is taken. A big appeal for the catch and it's given by the umpire. Shakib opts for the review and replays confirm that there is no bat or glove involved. The ball purely came off the pad and so the on-field call has to be reversed.
Shakib has been given out caught. He has gone for a review.
Full and on the pads, leans across and works it on the leg side.
Fuller ball around off, Shakib goes for the sweep but misses.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and blocks it well.
Floated outside off, spins in a bit to ping Shakib on the front pad. There was a faint inside edge.
Fired in on  length outside off, sits back and drives it to extra cover where it is well stopped. Single taken.
Speared in on the pads, gets back and works it behind square leg for a couple.
FOUR! SPANKED! Pushed through quicker but a bit short outside off, stays back and cuts it away through cover-point to find the fence. That's a favorite scoring zone for the veteran southpaw.
Drifting away from outside off, leans forward and eases it towards cover.
Looped up on middle and off, Shakib pushes at it but gets it off the outside edge past slip towards third man for a brace.
Drifting in on a length outside off, gets back and blocks it to the off side.
Floated on middle, some sidespin on the ball and keeps low as Shakib gets his bat down just in time.
Flighted wider outside off, Mahmudullah goes for the expansive drive but cannot beat point.
Full and outside off, reaches out and taps it towards silly point.
Quicker ball outside off, blocked well from the crease.
Fuller around off, leans forward and drives it firmly towards extra cover.
Darted in outside off, Mahmudullah camps back and blocks firmly.
Quicker ball on off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Flighted on middle and leg, Shakib is down the track again and has to check his shot towards mid off.
Tossed up outside off, uses his feet and pushes it to silly mid off as Ashwin gets across to stop the ball.
Flatter outside off, sits back and blocks it firmly to cover.
Fuller around off, gets well forward and blocks it solidly.
Flighted on leg stump, Shakib looks to block but gets it off the outside edge to point.
SHAKIB AL HASAN is the new man in.

OUT! RAHANE DOES IT AGAIN! An easier catch this time and Ashwin has his second wicket. Floated ball around leg which is turning away, Mominul has a push at it and gets a thick edge that flies straight to Ajinkya at first slip. Bangladesh are suddenly looking very vulnerable with India's spin twins breathing fire.
Tossed up from around off, covers the line and defends towards silly point.
Quicker ball on middle and leg, leans across and clips it towards short leg.
Loopy outside off, reaches out and pats it towards short cover.
Fuller on middle and off, leans forward and defends it on to the track.
Slider on middle and leg, stays back and works it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Floated on middle and leg, presses forward to that one and blocks it.
Quicker ball on middle, stays back and whips it past mid-wicket for a brace as Ishant tidies up in the deep.
Full and outside off, gets well forward and blocks solidly.
Tossed up outside off, reaches out to that one and pats it to the covers.
Flatter on middle and off, stays on the back foot and blocks it.
Drifting in from around off, Mominul blocks it off the bottom half of the bat on to the pad.
Flighted around off, leans into it and blocks with a straight bat.
RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN is back on.
MAHMUDULLAH is the new man in.

OUT! BLINDER FROM RAHANE! Sarkar's resistance comes to an end and it's the other spin twin who provides the second wicket of the innings. Flatter outside off, Sarkar pushes hard at it but gets a thick edge that flies to first slip where Rahane sticks out his right hand in reflex to take an excellent catch. Timely strike for the Indians as this was a very promising stand.
That was tight! Fuller outside off, pushed towards mid off for a sharp single. Mominul puts in the dive to get the run as the throw from Ashwin at the bowler's end misses.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Speared in around off, gets back and defends it towards short mid-wicket.
Full and wide outside off, forces Mominul to reach out and he mistimes the drive back to the bowler.
A touch short outside off, stays back and pushes it towards cover. Single taken.
Bumper to end the over, Mominum ducks under it.
Full and outside off, presses forward and blocks well.
Slips it down the leg side, no stroke offered to that one.
Fuller around off, stays back and blocks it well on to the track as the ball rolls to the off side. Quick single taken.
Length ball outside off, punched towards mid off for a single.
Full and outside off, creamed through the covers nicely. Jadeja chases from point with Kumar for company and the former cuts it down. A brace taken.
FOUR! Smartly done! Flatter outside off, stays back to that one and glides it with an open face past first slip towards third man fence for a boundary.
Flighted on middle, leans across and nudges it with the turn towards leg slip where Kohli makes a good stop.
Drifting in on a length outside off, stays back to block it on to the track.
Floated around off, nudges it with the turn towards leg slip.
On a length outside off, spinning in, left alone by Sarkar. That came off the rough marks.

FOUR! FINE SHOT! Decides to take on Jadeja straightaway. Tossed up outside off, he steps out to that one and launches it straight back past the bowler. Beats mid on easily to find the fence. Brings up the 50-run stand between these two.
RAVINDRA JADEJA comes into the attack.
Fuller ball outside off, drives loosely away from the body but gets a thick edge that goes on the bounce to gully.
Very full on middle, dug out back to the bowler down the pitch.
Back of a length around leg, nudged towards short fine leg for a single.
Dug in short on off, Mominul arches his back to evade the bumper.
Once again drifting on the pads, gets back and clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Dug in short down the leg side, that's an easy leave for the batsman.
Drinks break.....
Carrom ball outside off, Sarkar has let that through to the keeper.
Sarkar plays inside the line of the ball intentionally towards the delivery tossed outside off.
Sarkar prods forward to defend it.

NOT OUT! India have wasted a review. Carrom ball pitched outside off and Sarkar goes to drive at it. He is totally beaten and the ball goes straight to the keeper. Saha collects it and dislodges the bails. The players appeal for a caught behind but the umpire says no. Kohli consults Rahane and Ashwin before taking the DRS. Replays show there was day-light between bat and pad. They further check for a stumping chance but Sarkar was always safe inside his crease.
India have taken a review again for a caught behind. Rahane and Ashwin seem confident.
Outside off, left alone.
Tossed up outside off, Sarkar defends it towards point.
There is an unorthodox field set by Kohli. Murali Vijay is standing at deep gully.
Length ball outside off, Sarkar first thinks of leaving it but manages to find the bottom edge of the bat and guide it towards the fielder at gully.
Down the leg side, Sarkar clips it towards fine leg for a single.
Angling into the pads, Mominul hops and plays it towards deep square leg for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone by Mominul.
Angling into the stumps, Sarkar clips it through mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Short and wide outside off, Sarkar defends this one towards the fielder at point.
Umesh Yadav will bowl the next over.
Full on the stumps, Mominul digs it out towards the fielder at covers.
Tossed up, Haque lunges forward to defend.
Drifting down the leg side, Mominul tries to clip it on the leg side but misses. The ball goes onto hit the pads and the players appeal. The umpire says no and it was surely going down the leg side.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Tossed up outside off, Haque defends this towards the point fielder off the front foot.
Floated up in the line of the stumps, Mominul prods forward and defends it.
Angling into the stumps, Sarkar stays deep in his crease to defend the last ball of the over.

EDGED AND FOUR! Again a delivery on a good length, Soumya stays in his crease and goes to defend. The ball catches the outside edge and goes through the region between second slip and gully for a boundary. Lucky there.
Good length delivery, nipping away a bit. Soumya Sarkar tries to defend it but is totally foxed by the away movement.
FOUR! CRISPY! Full and wide outside off, Sarkar leans into it and drives it beautifully through the cover region for a boundary. Everything was right in that shot.
Full on the stumps, Sarkar has his defence well in place.
Angling into the stumps, Sarkar defends it towards the fielder at mid on.

OUT! GOOD REVIEW BY KOHLI! Floated ball outside off, Tamim looks to push at it with hard hands as the ball bobbles towards Kohli at gully. Huge appeal, initially for lbw, is turned down although Virat was appealing for a catch. After a chat with his players, he opts for the review, indicating to the umpire that it is for a catch. Replays confirm that there was a healthy inside edge and so it is a terrific review. The on-field call is reversed and Tamim has to go. Early blow for Bangladesh.
